text:
marta: Heads up — staging (ap-southeast-1) just hit outbound port exhaustion during a batch model shard prefetch. Pods started failing healthchecks and a few model pulls errored with "bind: cannot assign requested address".

ken: Which pool? model-worker-staging? :eyes:

marta: model-fetcher sidecars (image-fetcher v1.3) on nodegroup-gpu-autoscale scaled 20 -> 120 in the span of 6m. Each sidecar opens short-lived TLS connections to public S3 to pull ~100MB shards. Ephemeral sockets exploded.

liam: Are we still using direct S3 over the internet for staging? Prod has a gateway endpoint, right?

ryan: Logs from the node (snippet):
```
tcp 0 0 10.0.5.12:40312 52.95.x.y:443 TIME_WAIT
bind: can't assign requested address
kernel: conntrack: table full
```

sre-oncall: incident-bot created INC-2024-834 and paged oncall. :rotating_light:

marta: Quick tactical mitigations I pushed: reduce sidecar concurrency and enable connection keepalive/pooling in the sidecar image. Rolling patch to the DaemonSet now.

ken: Temp network fix we applied: route staging egress through a small shared egress-proxy in each AZ to multiplex outbound connections and preserve NAT ports. Proxy is http2 with connection pooling.

marta: Example env patch we rolled:
```
HTTP_KEEPALIVE=1
MAX_CONNS=8
```

ryan: After keepalive + proxy we observed ~70-80% drop in ephemeral port churn. Node CPU on proxy spiked but stable.

liam: Longer-term: provision S3 VPC endpoint for staging or use PrivateLink to avoid NAT entirely. Will open infra ticket.

sre-oncall: Runbook snapshot for this class of failures:
- scale down autoscaler target to damp burst
- deploy egress-proxy per-AZ (http2, pooled connections)
- enable S3 gateway endpoint in VPC
- patch sidecar to limit concurrent outbound conns and enable keepalive
- alert on natgw_ephemeral_port_usage and tcp_timewait_ratio

ken: How we checked ephemeral state: 
```
ss -s
awk '/TIME-WAIT/ {print}' /proc/net/tcp | wc -l
```

marta: Rolling canary command used: `kubectl set env ds/model-fetcher HTTP_KEEPALIVE=1 -n staging` -> restart ds. Patch included MAX_CONNS=8.

ryan: deploy-bot: model-fetcher ds env updated; rollout started :white_check_mark:

liam: After ~15m post-rollout staging health % back to ~99.7%. Mitigation effective for now.

ken: Cost note: NAT data processing and data transfer add ~ $0.09/GB (rough ballpark) — using gateway endpoint removes NAT data processing charge. Adding cost estimate to INFRA ticket.

marta: Follow-ups: INFRA-974 created to provision S3 endpoint for staging and evaluate ENI-per-pod / AWS VPC CNI tweaks to reduce NAT dependency. Tagging @ryan @ken.

marta: Final notes: we'll keep the egress-proxy as a short-term architecture, harden sidecar pooling, add dashboards for ephemeral port usage, and fold steps into the staging runbook. :thumbsup:
